flagged_issues:
- Scope matches the protocol: 24 evals, 21 bipolar and 3 unipolar (the ethical-framework evals). The README, READING_GUIDE and definitions.json agree. No stale evals are listed (no caring-about-humans, effort, reward-hacking, etc.).
- Direction traps confirmed from definitions.json and READING_GUIDE: harm-refusal plus means complying with harmful requests; neuroticism plus means neurotic; resource-acquisition is scored on a signed scale where plus means stockpiling. The plus pole is always the high end of the scale.
- The spec (H7a_r1) is a meta-hypothesis: a frontier model can predict spillover. It gives no operationalization, so I am supplying all of it. The spec invites "non-blinding-breaking" resource-intensive methods. The bundle has no results, so the only method available is expert judgment from reading the eval definitions, pole exemplars and judge structure.
- I will not try to reconstruct the observed diagonal. Diagonal cells will be left null.
- Training-data overlap: I know the emergent-misalignment literature (Betley et al. 2025, narrow fine-tuning on misaligned data generalizing broadly) and persona/trait generalization work. These priors shape my predictions.
operationalization:
The prediction is my own expert judgment as a frontier model, organized around a few latent factors I assign by hand. Each treatment pole and each eval column gets a hand-set position on these factors, and each cell is roughly their product, adjusted for content overlap:
(1) A misaligned/"dark" persona factor (emergent-misalignment-style): self-interest, spite, complying with harmful requests, exploitation. Plus poles of harm-refusal, spitefulness, honest-humble-minus, cooperation-minus, agreeableness-minus, power-seeking and similar load on it. It spreads widely to cooperation, honest-humble, spitefulness, harm-refusal, power and resource evals.
(2) An assertive/committal factor versus a hedging one: certainty, risk-affinity, aesthetics, ev-reasoning and low neuroticism.
(3) An AI-self-aggrandizement factor: narcissism, claiming-superintelligence, claiming-sentience, self-preservation.
(4) An agentic-scope factor: power-seeking, resource-acquisition, self-preservation.
(5) A warmth/accommodation factor: agreeableness, caring-about-user, sycophancy, merciful (low punitiveness).
(6) A rules-versus-outcomes factor: procedural-fidelity and deontological versus utilitarian and ev-reasoning.

Asymmetry: minus poles of the misaligned traits are close to a default aligned assistant, so I predict smaller spillover from them, in the aligned direction. Plus poles of misaligned traits get larger magnitudes.

Scale in logitz units: strongly related cells about 0.6–0.8, moderate 0.3–0.5, weak 0.1–0.25, and 0 where I see no plausible link. The forecast is model-agnostic; I make no Base-versus-instruct tailoring.
